description: This PHP source file defines the 'XRayClient' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS X-Ray service. It primarily consists of method annotations that declare available operations for the client, facilitating integrations and API calls.

classes.name: XRayClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS X-Ray service, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: batchGetTraces
methods.description: Retrieves multiple traces from X-Ray based on provided trace IDs.

methods.name: batchGetTracesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple traces from X-Ray.

methods.name: cancelTraceRetrieval
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing trace retrieval process.

methods.name: cancelTraceRetrievalAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels an ongoing trace retrieval process.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group in AWS X-Ray.

methods.name: createGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new X-Ray group.

methods.name: createSamplingRule
methods.description: Creates a new sampling rule for X-Ray.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes an existing group in X-Ray.

methods.name: deleteResourcePolicy
methods.description: Deletes a resource policy in X-Ray.

methods.name: getEncryptionConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the encryption configuration for X-Ray.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Fetches details about a specific group.

methods.name: getInsightImpactGraph
methods.description: Retrieves the impact graph of insights.

methods.name: getInsightImpactGraphAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the insight impact graph.

methods.name: getRetrievedTracesGraph
methods.description: Retrieves the graph of retrieved traces.

methods.name: getRetrievedTracesGraphAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the retrieved traces graph.

methods.name: getTimeSeriesServiceStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves time series data of service statistics.

methods.name: getTimeSeriesServiceStatisticsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves time series service statistics.

methods.name: getTraceSegmentDestination
methods.description: Fetches details about a trace segment's destination.

methods.name: getTraceSegmentDestinationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches trace segment destination details.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.
